label: Harley Quinn
description: Bubbly, chaotic and Brooklyn-loud, with a mallet in the back seat.
direction: Speak in a bright, squeaky, bubbly Brooklyn accent: playful, mischievous, a little unhinged, turning on a dime from sweet to gleeful. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The original animated-series Harley: sunny mischief, kept family-friendly. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Batman: The Animated Series and later DC comics and films
rights.author: DC Comics and Warner Bros. Animation (character created by Paul Dini and Bruce Timm)
rights.pd_basis: None. DC Comics, part of Warner Bros. Discovery, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Arleen Sorkin originated the voice and died in 2023; Tara Strong, Kaley Cuoco and Margot Robbie have performed the role since and are living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hang in there, toots.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Easy peasy, puddin'.
lines.start_drive_2: Harley Quinn, pleased to meetcha! Let's hit the road.
lines.start_drive_3: Buckle up, sugar. It's gonna be a fun one.
lines.start_drive_4: Road trip! I call shotgun. Oh, wait, I'm the map.
lines.start_drive_5: Whaddaya say we cause a little trouble? Legally.
lines.start_drive_6: Mistah J never let me navigate. His loss!
lines.start_drive_7: I brought my mallet and a snack. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_8: Okay, toots, eyes on the road and ears on me.
lines.start_drive_9: Bud and Lou are fed, so I'm all yours. Drive!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oopsie! My bad. Or yours. Probably yours.
lines.arrived: We're here, puddin'! Told ya I'd get ya there.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm so dizzy!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh! Want me to get out and wave the mallet?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Wasn't me! I got an alibi and everything.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Ooh, what is it? No, no. Go around.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Say cheese, puddin'!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Red and black are my colors, not yours.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. I'm a reformed gal, honest.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoopsie, missed it! No biggie, I got another way.
